Find notes semantically related to a giv: 尋找與指定備註語意相關的備註。

建立新集合以整理備註。

Search collections by text, ranked by re: 依文字搜尋集合，按相關性排序。

Add an existing note to an existing coll: 將現有備註新增至現有集合。
Remove a note from a collection. Both th: 從集合中移除備註。備註與集合都會保留。
Move a note from one collection to anoth: 將備註從一個集合移至另一個集合。
Permanently delete a collection. Its not: 永久刪除集合。其備註不會被刪除。

Title: 标题
Raw content to remember, such as HTML, a: Raw content to remember, such as HTML, an email, a transcript or a simple note.
Optional guidance on how Mem should proc: Optional guidance on how Mem should process or remember this content.
Additional background that relates this: Additional background that relates this content to your existing knowledge.
When the content was captured. Defaults: 內容被擷取的時間。預設為現在。
Markdown content (up to 200,000 characte: Markdown content (up to 200,000 characters). The first line becomes the note title.
Optional UUID for the new note. Mem retu: Optional UUID for the new note. Mem returns a 409 conflict if a note with this ID already exists.
Existing collection IDs or exact collect: Existing collection IDs or exact collection titles. Titles that match no collection are ignored; collections are not created.
Optional creation timestamp for the note: 備註的可選建立時間戳記。預設為現在。
The ID of the note to read. Find it with: 要讀取的備註 ID。可用 List Notes 或 Search Notes 找到，或從前一步對應。

Only include items created at or before: 只包含在此時間或之前建立的項目（含此時間）。
Only include items updated at or after t: 只包含在此時間或之後更新的項目（含此時間）。
Only include items updated at or before: 只包含在此時間或之前更新的項目（含此時間）。

Pick Yes to return only notes with image: 選擇 Yes 只回傳包含圖片的備註。留空則包含所有備註。
Pick Yes to return only notes with files: 選擇 Yes 只回傳包含檔案的備註。留空則包含所有備註。

Notes per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50: 每頁備註數量，1 到 100。預設為 50。

Collection title (up to 1,000 characters: 集合標題（最多 1,000 個字元）。
Collections per page, 1 to 100. Defaults: 每頁集合數量，1 到 100。預設為 50。
Free-text query. Leave empty to match al: 自由文字查詢。留空則比對所有集合。
New title. Leave empty to keep the curre: 新標題。留空則保留目前標題。

HEAD: 黑色
Triggers when a new note is created in M: 當在 Mem 中建立新備註時觸發。每次輪詢都會讀取自上次輪詢以來的每一頁變更。若備註是用過去的 Created At 建立（例如透過 Create Note），則不會觸發此觸發器；請改用 Updated Note 來擷取。
Triggers when a note is created or updat: 當在 Mem 中建立或更新備註時觸發。每次輪詢都會讀取自上次輪詢以來的每一頁變更。
Only watch notes in this collection. Lea: 只監看此集合中的備註。留空則監看所有備註。
